strategy_roster.name: Williams %R Cross Strategy with 200 MA Filter
strategy_roster.entry_long: donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14) > 0 and crossabove(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -40) and close > sma(close,200)
strategy_roster.exit_long: donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14) > 0 and crossbelow(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), -60) or close < sma(close,200)
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R(14) is rebuilt from the documented Donchian window with a non-zero range guard, and the -50 level plus CrossThreshold=10 gives the -40/-60 pair, filtered by SMA(200). The documented 20/30 unit take-profit and stop-loss are absolute price distances, so the percent fields stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Two EMA Intraday Filter
strategy_roster.notes: The FastEmaPeriod=5 / SlowEmaPeriod=30 crossover is exact and the reverse cross closes the long. The 1.2-ATR limit shift, 5x/8x ATR stop and target, four-bar order expiration, and the minute/hour/day filters are not expressible in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: EMA RSI Volatility Adaptive Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: The documented rule is followed literally: a long opens when the slow line crosses below the fast line and the next opposite crossover reverses it. ema() needs an integer length, so the RSI-driven adaptive period (RSI 310/200) is replaced by the base SlowEmaPeriod=40 and FastEmaPeriod=50; the point legs are disabled by default.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Skyscraper Fix + ColorAML + X2MA Candle MMRec
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(sma(close,12),5) and close > sma(close,10) + 0.9 * atr(high,low,close,10)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < sma(sma(close,12),5) or close < sma(close,10) - 0.9 * atr(high,low,close,10)
strategy_roster.notes: Two of the three colour blocks are expressible and are combined: X2MA double smoothing (12 then 5, SMA standing in for JJMA) and the Skyscraper Fix midline plus 0.9*ATR(10) envelope. The ColorAML adaptive level, Jurik phases, gap points, signal-bar offsets, and the per-block loss-streak money management are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Dealers Trade v7.51 RIVOT (C#)
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > (donchian_high_prev(high,1) + donchian_low_prev(low,1) + close) / 4 and close > (high + low + close) / 3 and ((donchian_high_prev(high,1) + donchian_low_prev(low,1) + close) / 4 - (high + low + close) / 3) / close * 100 > 0.07 or ((high + low + close) / 3 - (donchian_high_prev(high,1) + donchian_low_prev(low,1) + close) / 4) / close * 100 > 0.07
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < (high + low + close) / 3 or close < sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Both documented pivots are implemented (P from the prior bar's high/low with the current close standing in for the previous close, FLP as the current-bar average) and GapThreshold=7 pips is converted to a 0.07% gap. The martingale scaling, volume multiplier, and the 15/90/15 pip target, stop, and trail are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: EurGbp EA
strategy_roster.notes: The relative comparison of EUR/USD and GBP/USD MACD needs two external instruments the single-security DSL cannot load, so momentum is reduced to the traded instrument's own MACD line above its signal and rising. The 75/46 price-step stop and target are not percent fields.

strategy_roster.name: At Random Full
strategy_roster.notes: Entries come from a pseudo-random generator (RandomSeed, ReverseSignals) with no market-derived condition, so the never-true negative-price guard prevents inventing a signal. The grid spacing, averaging, session window, and the 150/460-point protections are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Williams %R Divergence
strategy_roster.entry_long: donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14) > 0 and close < donchian_low_prev(low,5) and roc(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)), 1) > 0 and bars_since(-100 * (donchian_high(high,14) - close) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)) < -80) <= 3
strategy_roster.notes: A new DivergencePeriod=5 low while Williams %R(14) ticks up and was below -80 within the last three bars is the documented bullish divergence, and RSI(14)>50 stands in for the %R return to the opposite extreme. StopLossPercent=2 becomes the documented 2.0 percent stop; the 5-minute series and take profit are not supplied.

strategy_roster.name: ValidateMe
strategy_roster.notes: This is a broker-validation harness: it checks funds and exchange limits, then fires one order in a user-chosen direction with no market-derived entry condition, so the never-true guard is used. Pip distances, lot size, and the direction switch have no DSL representation.

strategy_roster.name: AntiFragile EA
strategy_roster.notes: The docs list no indicators: entries are fifty layered limit orders spaced 700 price steps from the bid/ask with rising volume, so there is no directional market signal to translate. The 300-pip initial stop, 100-pip trailing, and 1-minute series are outside the DSL.
